# Within-species reference-based annotation

Reference: <https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/collections/f11cb29c-b546-4738-9bd8-66ea621a7bd5>

```{r}
human_ref = read_h5ad('data/02_annotation_refs/human.h5ad')
human_ref = human_ref$as_Seurat()
human_ref = human_ref |> 
  subset(control_vs_disease == 'control') |> 
  subset(organ_unified |> str_detect('colon')) |> 
  subset(donor_disease %in% c('control', 'organ_donor')) |> 
  subset(!sample_retrieval %in% c('Medical_termination', 'Oral sample', 'Unspecified')) |> 
  subset(sample_category == 'Non_pathological')
# human.h5ad (CELLxGENE) X is log1p(CP10k): undo the log so NormalizeData() below gives back X
human_ref@assays$RNA$counts = expm1(human_ref@assays$RNA$X)
human_ref = human_ref |> 
  NormalizeData()
rownames(human) = human@assays$Xenium@meta.data$ensembl_id
human_shared_genes = rownames(human_ref) |> 
  intersect(rownames(human))
human_ref = human_ref[human_shared_genes,]

human_cells = human_ref$level_2_annot
human_ref$cell_type_regroup = case_when(
  human_cells %in% c('Absorptive') ~ 'Epithelial: Absorptive',
  
  human_cells %in% c('Secretory', 'Enteroendocrine') ~ 'Epithelial: Secretory',
  
  human_cells %in% c('Epithelial_stem', 'Transit_amplifying') ~ 'Epithelial: Stem/Progenitor',
  
  human_cells %in% c('Vascular_endothelia', 'Lymphatic_endothelia', 'Cycling_endothelia') ~ 'Endothelial',
  
  human_cells %in% c('Fibroblast', 'Myofibroblast', 'Pericyte', 'Mesothelium', 'Lymphoid_stromal_cell') ~ 'Stromal/Mesenchymal',
  
  human_cells %in% c('Smooth_muscle') ~ 'Smooth muscle',
  
  human_cells %in% c('Glia', 'Neuron', 'Neuron_progenitor') ~ 'Neural/Glial',
  
  human_cells %in% c('Mature_B', 'Immature_B', 'B_plasma') ~ 'B/Plasma',
  
  human_cells %in% c('Conventional_CD4', 'Conventional_CD8', 'Treg', 'NK', 'Unconventional_T/ILC', 'Cycling_T/NK', 'DC', 'Macrophage', 'Monocyte', 'Granulocyte') ~ 'Immune',
  
  human_cells %in% c('Erythrocyte') ~ 'Erythroid'
)

SaveSeuratRds(human_ref, 'data/02_annotation_refs/human_processed_human_use.rds')
```

## Seurat

```{r}
human_ref = readRDS('data/02_annotation_refs/human_processed_human_use.rds')
human = human |> 
  NormalizeData() |> 
  ScaleData() |> 
  RunPCA(features = rownames(human)) |> 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:20, return.model = TRUE) |> 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = 'pca', dims = 1:20)

human_ref = human_ref |> 
  ScaleData() |> 
  RunPCA(features = rownames(human_ref)) |> 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:20, return.model = TRUE) |> 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = 'pca', dims = 1:20)

rownames(human) = human@assays$Xenium@meta.data$ensembl_id

human_seurat_label = LabelTransfer(data = human, ref = human_ref)
human$celltype_seurat = human_seurat_label$cell_type_transfer
human$labelscore_seurat = human_seurat_label$score_transfer
SaveSeuratRds(human, 'data/02_annotated_data/02_human_annotated.rds')
```

```{r}
human = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_human_annotated.rds')
ImageDimPlot(human, group.by = 'celltype_seurat')

  geom_histogram()
ggplot(human@meta.data, aes(x = celltype_seurat, y = labelscore_seurat)) +
  geom_boxplot()
DimPlot(human, reduction = 'umap', group.by = 'celltype_seurat',
        shuffle = TRUE)
```

# Cross-species reference-based annotation

Reference: <https://www.parsebiosciences.com/datasets/5-million-mouse-single-cell-atlas-from-7-tissues/>

```{r}
mouse_ref_adata = read_h5ad('data/02_annotation_refs/mouse.h5ad')
mouse_count_matrix = t(mouse_ref_adata$X)
colnames(mouse_count_matrix) = mouse_ref_adata$obs$cell_ids
rownames(mouse_count_matrix) = mouse_ref_adata$var |> rownames()
mouse_metadata = as.data.frame(mouse_ref_adata$obs)
# the obs index (0, 1, ..., "0-1") is not cell_ids, and CreateSeuratObject matches
# meta.data rows to cells by name: name them like the count matrix columns
rownames(mouse_metadata) = mouse_ref_adata$obs$cell_ids
stopifnot(identical(rownames(mouse_metadata), colnames(mouse_count_matrix)))
mouse_metadata$barcode = mouse_metadata$barcode |> 
  str_remove('_5d84e6de$')
mouse_ref = CreateSeuratObject(counts = mouse_count_matrix,
                               meta.data = mouse_metadata)
# transfer dimensional reduction (umap)
mouse_umap_coords = mouse_ref_adata$obsm$X_umap
rownames(mouse_umap_coords) = mouse_ref_adata$obs$cell_ids
colnames(mouse_umap_coords) = c('UMAP_1', 'UMAP_2')
mouse_ref[['umap']] = CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = mouse_umap_coords,
                                           key = 'UMAP_',
                                           assay = 'RNA')
mouse_ref = mouse_ref |> 
  NormalizeData()

homology_tbl = read.csv('../homology_tbl.csv')
mouse_ref_human = concatenate(human_data = human, 
                              mouse_data = mouse_ref, homology_tbl = homology_tbl,
                              tech_mouse = 'RNA')
# concatenate() already renames the mouse genes to their human orthologs;
# renaming again from the Xenium feature metadata scrambles the gene names
DefaultAssay(mouse_ref_human) = 'RNA'
DefaultLayer(mouse_ref_human[['RNA']]) = 'data'
mouse_ref_human = mouse_ref_human |> 
  subset(orig.ident == 'mmusculus')

mouse_ref_human$nCount_RNA = colSums(x = mouse_ref_human[['RNA']]$counts)
mouse_ref_human = mouse_ref_human |> 
  subset(nCount_RNA > 0)

mouse_ref_human@meta.data = mouse_ref_human@meta.data |> 
  mutate(across(c(B.Cell, Colonocyte.DCC, Enteric.Glial, Enteric.Neuron, Enterocyte,
                  Fibroblast, Goblet, Immune, PCC, Mesothelial, `Plasma.Cell`, 
                  `Smooth.Muscle`, `Stem.TA`, Tuft, `Vascular.Endothelial`, Unknown), 
                ~ na_if(.x, 'None'))) |> 
  mutate(cell_type_detailed = coalesce(B.Cell, Colonocyte.DCC, Enteric.Glial, 
                                       Enterocyte, Enteric.Neuron, Fibroblast, Goblet, 
                                       Immune, PCC, Mesothelial, Plasma.Cell, 
                                       Smooth.Muscle, Stem.TA, Tuft, 
                                       Vascular.Endothelial, Unknown))
mouse_ref_human = mouse_ref_human |> 
  subset(!is.na(cell_type_detailed) & !cell_type_detailed == 'Unknown')

mouse_cells = mouse_ref_human$cell_type_detailed
mouse_ref_human$cell_type_regroup = case_when(
  mouse_cells %in% c('Colonocyte/DCC', 'PCC', 'Enterocyte') ~ 'Epithelial: Absorptive',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Goblet', 'Tuft') ~ 'Epithelial: Secretory',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Stem/TA') ~ 'Epithelial: Stem/Progenitor',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Vascular Endothelial') ~ 'Endothelial',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Fibroblast', 'Mesothelial') ~ 'Stromal/Mesenchymal',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Smooth Muscle') ~ 'Smooth muscle',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Enteric Glial', 'Enteric Neuron') ~ 'Neural/Glial',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('B Cell', 'Plasma Cell') ~ 'B/Plasma',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Immune') ~ 'Immune'
)

SaveSeuratRds(mouse_ref_human, 'data/02_annotation_refs/mouse_processed_human_use.rds')
```

## Dawid-Skene algorithm

```{r}
human = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_human_annotated.rds')
human$celltype_seurat = human$celltype_seurat |> 
  as.factor()
human$celltype_singleR = human$celltype_singleR |> 
  as.factor()
human$celltype_seurat_cross = human$celltype_seurat_cross |> 
  as.factor()
human$celltype_singleR_cross = human$celltype_singleR_cross |> 
  as.factor()
human$majority_vote = human@meta.data |> 
  dplyr::select(celltype_seurat,
                celltype_singleR,
                celltype_seurat_cross,
                celltype_singleR_cross) |> 
  apply(MARGIN = 1,
        FUN = function(x) majorityVote(x)$majority) |> 
  as.factor()
```

```{r}
ann_cols = c("celltype_seurat", "celltype_singleR",
             "celltype_seurat_cross", "celltype_singleR_cross")
keep = with(human@meta.data,
            !is.na(celltype_seurat) & !is.na(celltype_singleR) &
              !is.na(celltype_seurat_cross) & !is.na(celltype_singleR_cross))
X = lapply(ann_cols, function(col) as.character(human@meta.data[[col]][keep]))
names(X) = ann_cols
J = length(X)
I = length(X[[1]])

celltypes = X |> unlist() |> unique() |> sort()
K = length(celltypes)

# indicator matrix
indicator = function(vec, classes) {
  m = matrix(0, length(vec), length(classes), 
             dimnames = list(NULL, classes))
  m[cbind(seq_along(vec), match(vec, classes))] = 1
  return(m)
}
Z = lapply(X, FUN = indicator, classes = celltypes)

T_hat = human$majority_vote[keep] |>  
  as.character() |> 
  indicator(celltypes)

eps = 0.5

m_step = function(T_hat) {
  p  = (colSums(T_hat) + eps) / (I + K * eps)
  pi = lapply(Z, function(Zj) {
    N  = t(T_hat) %*% Zj + eps
    N/rowSums(N)
  })
  return(list(p = p, pi = pi))
}

e_step = function(p, pi) {
  logT = matrix(log(p), nrow = I, ncol = K, byrow = TRUE,
                dimnames = list(NULL, celltypes))
  for (j in seq_len(J)) {
    logT = logT + Z[[j]] %*% t(log(pi[[j]]))
  }
  logT = logT - apply(logT, 1, max)
  T_hat = exp(logT)
  return(T_hat/rowSums(T_hat))
}

loglik = function(p, pi) {
  logS = matrix(log(p), nrow = I, ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
  for (j in seq_len(J)) logS = logS + Z[[j]] %*% t(log(pi[[j]]))
  m = apply(logS, 1, max)
  sum(m + log(rowSums(exp(logS - m))))
}

maxit = 1000
tol = 1e-6
prev_labels = max.col(T_hat)
prev_ll = -Inf
it = 1
while (TRUE) {
  par = m_step(T_hat)
  T_hat = e_step(par$p, par$pi)
  ll = loglik(par$p, par$pi)
  labels = max.col(T_hat)
  cat(sprintf("iter %3d | loglik %.2f | labels changed: %d\n",
              it, ll, sum(!labels == prev_labels)))
  if (all(labels == prev_labels) & abs(ll - prev_ll) < tol) break
  prev_labels = labels
  prev_ll = ll
  it = it + 1
}
saveRDS(par, 'data/02_annotated_data/human_ds_params.rds')
```

table(final_labels, human$celltype_singleR_cross[keep]) |> diag() |> sum()

    "MZB1", "JCHAIN", "DERL3", "XBP1", "PRDM1", "SDC1", "IGHA1", "IGHG1"
  ),
  Immune = c(
    "PTPRC",
    # T / NK
    "CD3D", "CD3E", "CD2", "CD8A", "NKG7",
    # Myeloid
    "LYZ", "CD68", "CD14", "C1QA", "ITGAM",
    # Mast
    "TPSAB1", "CPA3", "MS4A2"
  ),
  Erythroid = c(
    # membrane / cytoskeleton
    "SLC4A1", "SPTA1", "SPTB", "ANK1", "EPB41", "EPB42",
    "RHAG", "RHCE", "GYPB", "GYPC", "DMTN", "ADD2", "TMOD1",
    # heme / iron biosynthesis
    "ALAS2", "SLC25A37", "FECH", "UROD", "BLVRB", "AHSP",
    # transcription factors (less specific — don't use alone)
    "KLF1", "GATA1", "TAL1", "HEMGN"
  )
)

# keep genes on the panel, each gene once (first group wins)
present = lapply(markers, intersect, rownames(human))
seen = character(0)
for (g in names(present)) { present[[g]] = setdiff(present[[g]], seen); seen = c(seen, present[[g]]) }
present = present[lengths(present) > 0]
setdiff(unlist(markers), rownames(human))   # markers not on your panel

ann_cols = c("celltype_seurat", "celltype_singleR", 
  'celltype_seurat_cross', 'celltype_singleR_cross')
# hide one random annotator's label for 10% of cells
set.seed(1)
meta_ho = human@meta.data
ho = data.frame(cell = sample(nrow(meta_ho), round(0.1 * nrow(meta_ho))))
ho$ann   = sample(ann_cols, nrow(ho), replace = TRUE)
ho$truth = mapply(function(i, a) as.character(meta_ho[[a]][i]), ho$cell, ho$ann)
for (a in ann_cols) {
  meta_ho[[a]] = as.character(meta_ho[[a]])
  meta_ho[[a]][ho$cell[ho$ann == a]] = NA
}

DotPlot(human, features = markers, group.by = 'celltype_seurat') + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(human[,!is.na(human$celltype_singleR)], features = markers, group.by = 'celltype_singleR') + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(human, features = markers, group.by = 'celltype_seurat_cross') + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(human[,!is.na(human$celltype_singleR_cross)], features = markers, group.by = 'celltype_singleR_cross') + RotatedAxis()

trusted = list(
celltype_seurat = c('Epithelial: Absorptive', 'Endothelial', 'Stromal/Mesenchymal', 'Smooth muscle', 'B/Plasma'),
celltype_singleR  = c('Epithelial: Absorptive', 'Endothelial', 'Stromal/Mesenchymal', 'Smooth muscle', 'Neural/Glial', 'B/Plasma', 'Immune'),
celltype_seurat_cross = c('Epithelial: Absorptive', 'Endothelial', 'Stromal/Mesenchymal', 'Smooth muscle', 'B/Plasma'),
celltype_singleR_cross = c('Epithelial: Absorptive', 'Endothelial', 'Stromal/Mesenchymal', 'Smooth muscle', 'B/Plasma', 'Immune')
)
frac = 0.5
n_k = list(
  celltype_seurat = table(human$celltype_seurat),
  celltype_singleR = table(human$celltype_singleR),
  celltype_seurat_cross = table(human$celltype_seurat_cross),
  celltype_singleR_cross = table(human$celltype_singleR_cross)
)

# fit with M subtypes, then score how well the hidden labels are predicted
heldout_ll = function(M, R = 3) {
  beta = make_beta_prior(unique(c(human$celltype_singleR, human$celltype_singleR_cross)), ann_cols)
  for (a in names(trusted)) {for (k in trusted[[a]]){
  beta[[a]][k, k] = 4 + frac * n_k[[a]][[k]] / M }}
  f = run_ebcc(meta_ho, ann_cols, M = M, R = R, keep_rho = TRUE, beta = beta)
  lp = unlist(lapply(ann_cols, function(a) {
    s = ho[ho$ann == a, ]
    l = match(s$truth, f$classes); ok = !is.na(l)
    # P(hidden label) = sum over class-subtypes of P(cell in it) x P(annotator gives that label)
    log(rowSums(f$rho[s$cell[ok], , drop = FALSE] *
                t(f$par$v[[a]][, l[ok], drop = FALSE])))
  }))
  lp
}

Ms = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 10)
ll = sapply(Ms, heldout_ll)
mean(ll[,1])
mean(ll[,2])
mean(ll[,3])
mean(ll[,4])
mean(ll[,5])
mean(ll[,4]) - sd(ll[,4])/sqrt(dim(ll)[1])

# ---- fit ----
M = 5
beta = make_beta_prior(unique(c(human$celltype_singleR, human$celltype_singleR_cross)), ann_cols)
for (a in names(trusted)) for (k in trusted[[a]])
beta[[a]][k, k] = 4 + frac * n_k[[a]][[k]] / M 
fit = run_ebcc(human@meta.data, ann_cols, M = M, R = 10, beta = beta)

# ---- diagnostics ----
# 1. restarts: distance of each restart's ELBO from the best (large spread = many local optima)
round(fit$elbo_restarts - max(fit$elbo_restarts), 1)

# ---- save ----
human$ebcc_label   = fit$label
human$ebcc_maxpost = rowMaxs(fit$posterior)
human$ebcc_entropy = -rowSums(fit$posterior * log(fit$posterior + 1e-12))
human$celltype   = human$ebcc_label   # switch over only once the diagnostics look sound

VariableFeatures(human) = rownames(human)
human = human |> 
NormalizeData()  |> 
ScaleData()
human$celltype = human$ebcc_label
saveRDS(fit$par,       'data/02_annotated_data/human_ebcc_params.rds')
saveRDS(fit$posterior, 'data/02_annotated_data/human_ebcc_posterior.rds')
SaveSeuratRds(human, 'data/02_annotated_data/02_human_annotated.rds')
as.anndata(human, file_path = 'data/02_annotated_data/',
           file_name = '02_human_annotated.h5ad', assay = 'Xenium',
           main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
